name: 19038 · Glenside, PA
findings: ZIP 19038 (Glenside) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19038 (Glenside) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19038 (Glenside) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
